I reported Charlie’s body in weapons. My route was oxygen → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → security → weapons. I found the body right when I got to weapons.

My route was upper_engine → oxygen → back through upper_engine → medbay → electrical, where I was when the meeting got called. I only saw Eve this round: she came into upper_engine from oxygen at tick 1, and I saw her in upper_engine around ticks 2-4. After that I headed toward medbay/electrical and didn’t see her again.

I didn’t see Charlie at all, and I also didn’t see Alice, Bob, or Diana. I can confirm Eve’s early path lines up with what I saw, but I can’t vouch for her after upper_engine. Body being in weapons means whoever killed had to be on that right side later. I was in electrical, not weapons/security.

I started in cafeteria, then moved down to medbay and over to electrical. I actually saw Diana in electrical around tick 4, so I can confirm she was there early on. 

After that, I headed down to lower_engine to work on a task, and I was just making my way into storage when the meeting was called. I've been on the bottom left side of the map for the entire second half of the round, nowhere near weapons. I didn't see Charlie or anyone else after electrical. 

Since Eve found the body in weapons and came through security, we need to hear from Alice and Diana to see if either of them were on the right side of the ship later in the round.

My route was electrical → medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine. I started in electrical and saw Bob there around ticks 3-4; he came in from medbay, so that part of his story checks out and he saw me there too.

I also saw Eve pass through medbay around tick 7 — she came in from upper_engine and then went toward electrical, so that matches her route and Frank’s timing somewhat. I didn’t see Charlie at all.

Late in the round, I saw Alice in oxygen around tick 14. Since the body was in weapons and got reported at tick 17, Alice being in oxygen that late makes it hard for her to have killed right before the report, but she could still explain her full route.

Right now, Bob’s story lines up with mine early and he says he went bottom left after. Eve’s route lines up with what I saw, but she is also the one who found the body on the right side. I want to hear Alice before deciding — especially where she was before oxygen.

My route was medbay → storage → lower_engine → upper_engine → oxygen. I didn’t see Charlie at all, and I didn’t really cross paths with anyone until late — at around tick 14 I saw Diana leaving oxygen toward upper_engine, which matches what she said about seeing me in oxygen.

Given the body was in weapons and reported at tick 17, I don’t think Diana could have made that kill right before report if she was leaving oxygen at tick 14. Same for me — I was in oxygen then, and weapons is too far to get there, kill, and have Eve report immediately.

Bob and Diana vouch for each other early in electrical, but Bob isn’t confirmed later. Frank says he ended electrical, which is at least closer to security/weapons than the left side. Eve is the only one who admits reaching weapons and reporting, so self-report is possible, but her route is partially backed by Frank and Diana.

I don’t think we have a slam dunk. If we vote, my main concern is Eve or Frank due to right-side access, but I’m not confident enough to hard accuse. I’m leaning skip unless someone thinks Eve’s timing is too perfect.

I’ll restate my side: I came into weapons through security and found Charlie’s body immediately. I didn’t see anyone leaving weapons or security right then.

Frank says he ended in electrical, which is the closest confirmed late position to security/weapons besides me.

I know self-report is possible from everyone’s POV, but I’m goose and I reported as soon as I saw Charlie. My main suspicion right now is Frank just based on late right-side access, but I’m not 100% sure.

I get why my name comes up because I ended in electrical, but I want to be clear: I never went into security or weapons. My route stayed left/mid: upper_engine → oxygen → upper_engine → medbay → electrical, and I was in electrical when Eve reported.

The only person I actually saw was Eve in upper_engine early, ticks 2-4, and she had come from oxygen. After that I didn’t see anyone. So I can back up Eve’s early route, but not the security/weapons part.

For suspects, I don’t think Alice or Diana look likely for a late kill if they were both around oxygen at tick 14. I don’t think there’s enough to confidently vote. I’d rather skip than risk ejecting a goose here, but I’ll be watching Eve and Bob/late routes next round.

Yeah, I agree with the general consensus here. Like I mentioned, I spent the second half of the round down in lower_engine and then heading into storage, so I was nowhere near weapons when Charlie went down. 

Looking at the info we have: Alice and Diana crossing paths around oxygen at tick 14 makes it really hard for either of them to be the killer. That leaves the right side of the map as our main focus. 

Frank, you admit you ended up in electrical, which gives you the closest access to security and weapons out of anyone unconfirmed. And Eve, obviously you're the one who found the body, so a self-report is always a possibility we have to keep in mind. 

I know I don't have a late-round buddy to vouch for me, but it sounds like the killer has to be someone who was hanging around the right side. That said, guessing between Eve and Frank right now without hard proof is way too risky for us. A wrong vote here would be devastating. I think skipping is the smartest play, but we definitely need to keep a close eye on Frank and Eve next round. I'm voting skip.

For suspects, I agree it’s mostly between the people with late right-side access: Eve because she found/reported the body, and Frank because electrical is close to security/weapons. But I don’t think we have enough to confidently pick one without risking a goose. Bob is only confirmed early, but his claimed later path is far from weapons.

I’m leaning skip here, but next round we should watch Eve and Frank closely and try to stay paired.

I’ll keep it simple: my route was medbay → storage → lower_engine → upper_engine → oxygen. I never went right side, never saw Charlie, and the only relevant thing I saw was Diana leaving oxygen toward upper_engine around tick 14.

But I don’t think we have enough to choose between Eve and Frank safely. With only one duck, a bad vote hurts us a lot. I’m voting skip, and next round we should keep eyes on Eve/Frank and try to pair up.

I reported Eve’s body in Security. My route was Storage → Navigation → Security → Weapons → back to Security.

I saw Eve earlier in Upper Engine around tick 4, then in Navigation around tick 21. At tick 23 I saw Eve come into Security from Navigation, and Alice was also in/near Security then. Eve left toward Weapons. I went to Weapons and at tick 27 I saw Eve alive there with Diana; Bob also entered Weapons from Cafeteria, and Alice left Weapons toward Cafeteria. I also saw Bob leave Weapons toward Security at tick 27.

I went back to Security and found Eve dead there at tick 29, with Bob in Security when I reported. So the body was definitely in Security, and Bob is the person I saw closest to it right before the report.

Frank, listen to your own timeline because it actually clears me. You just admitted that at tick 27, Eve was alive in Weapons with you and Diana, and you saw me leave Weapons heading toward Security. I went straight there to do my Check Cameras task. 

If Eve was still in Weapons when I left, how am I the killer? Whoever killed her had to be someone who was still in Weapons with her—which means either you or Diana. I literally just walked into Security, found her body, and you immediately reported it before I even had the chance to press the button. Honestly, this looks like a blatant self-report to frame me since you were the last one with her. I'm voting Frank.

I was Electrical → Security → Weapons. At tick 23 I saw Eve enter Security from Navigation, then leave toward Weapons, and Frank also came into Security from Navigation. I followed toward Weapons and saw Eve alive there at ticks 25, 26, and 27. Frank entered Weapons from Security at 26. At 27 I saw Bob enter Weapons from Cafeteria and then leave toward Security, and Diana also entered Weapons from Cafeteria.

So Bob’s point isn’t fully clearing: Eve was alive in Weapons at 27, but she could have gone to Security right after Bob, since the body was found there at 29. That means Bob still had opportunity if Eve followed him. Frank also had opportunity because he was in Weapons with Eve and then reported in Security, so self-report is possible too. Diana was also there at 27, so I really need to hear from Diana whether she saw Eve leave Weapons and who went with her.

Right now Bob being found in Security with the body is suspicious, but Frank’s route also keeps him in the window. I’m not hard accusing yet, but I don’t think Bob is cleared by that timeline.

My route was lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons. I saw Bob in medbay around 24, then cafeteria 25, then he entered Weapons from cafeteria at 27. At 27 in Weapons I saw Alice, Bob, Eve, and Frank all there with me. The only movement I personally caught after that was Frank leaving Weapons toward Security at 28.

So Eve was definitely alive in Weapons at 27. Since the body is in Security at 29, the window is really tight and it points to someone going from Weapons/Security right then. That makes Bob and Frank the main suspects to me. Bob’s defense that he “couldn’t” have done it isn’t solid because Eve could have followed him to Security, but Frank also left toward Security right before reporting, so self-report is possible.

I’m leaning Frank right now because I specifically saw him leave Weapons toward Security at 28 and then he reports at 29, but Bob being found there is also bad. I don’t think Alice is the vote here.

Bob’s argument only sounds clearing if Eve stayed in Weapons after he left, but nobody has said they saw that. We all agree Bob left Weapons toward Security at 27, and I found Eve dead in Security at 29 with Bob there.

Diana, you saying you saw me leave Weapons toward Security at 28 is fair — I did go back to Security and reported immediately when I saw the body. But if I killed Eve there, Bob would have had to be standing right there with the body too. I don’t think that makes sense as a self-report frame when Bob was already in Security.

The key point is: Bob went Weapons → Security before me, Eve’s body is in Security, and Bob was in the room with it when I reported. I think Bob had the best opportunity here.

Diana, your timeline perfectly confirms what just happened. I was already in Security doing my Check Cameras task. Eve walked in at tick 28, and Frank followed her in right after, killed her, and slammed the report button at 29 before I could even process it. He panicked and self-reported because he realized I was standing right there and caught him red-handed! 

He’s trying to twist the narrative to frame me because I was in the room, but you literally saw him leave Weapons to follow her at 28. It's Frank, 100%. He's just trying to talk his way out of a messy kill. I'm voting Frank, and we need to get him out.

I want to point out something important: Bob’s story changed.

At first Bob said he went to Security for cameras, “found her body,” and Frank reported before he could. But now he’s saying Eve walked in at 28, Frank followed her, killed her, and self-reported while Bob was standing there. If Bob actually saw Frank kill, that should have been the very first thing he said, not only after Diana said Frank left Weapons.

From my POV, Eve was alive in Weapons at 27 with Bob, Frank, Diana, and me. I saw Bob enter from Cafeteria and then leave Weapons toward Security at 27. Diana says Frank left toward Security at 28. The body was in Security at 29, with Bob there, and Frank reporting.

So yes, Frank still had possible opportunity, but Bob was the first one I saw heading to Security, he was found with the body, and his explanation has gotten more specific only after hearing Diana’s info. That feels more like adapting a story than reporting what he actually saw.

I’m leaning Bob here.

I’m going to synthesize since I’m last here.

My hard info is the same: I came lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons. I saw Bob in medbay at 24, cafeteria at 25, then he entered Weapons from cafeteria at 27. At 27, Alice, Bob, Eve, Frank, and I were all in Weapons, and Eve was alive. The only movement after that I personally saw was Frank leaving Weapons toward Security at 28.

So yes, Frank had opportunity. I’m not ignoring that. But Bob’s story is the problem for me. His first defense was basically “I left before Eve, so I couldn’t have killed her, and I found the body.” Then after I mentioned Frank leaving at 28, Bob suddenly says Eve walked in, Frank followed, killed her in front of him, and self-reported. If Bob actually witnessed Frank kill Eve, that should have been the first thing he said, not something that developed later.

Also Alice and Frank both put Bob going toward Security first, the body is in Security, and Bob was there with it when Frank reported. I think Bob had the clearest opportunity and his story adapted to the discussion.

I’m voting Bob.
